heroHeadline: House Introduces $10B American Leadership in Fusion Act; Newsom Signs California Fusion Strategic Plan Law (SB 925)
heroSubtitle: On September 24, House Science leaders Zoe Lofgren and Jay Obernolte introduced the bipartisan American Leadership in Fusion Act, proposing $10 billion for test facilities, a milestone-based demonstration program and an Office of Fusion at DOE. On September 30, Governor Newsom signed SB 925, directing the California Energy Commission to develop a statewide fusion strategic plan covering R&D, siting and licensing.
